meta.name: Faadu
meta.description: Set in the year of the Indian economic meltdown, Abhay, an angry poet and dreamer from the dusty chawl of Kanjurmarg, aspires for a rags-to-riches story for himself. In this ambitious journey, he falls in love with Manjiri, a poetess with a starkly different view on life.

videos.title: Diamond In The Rough
videos.overview: Abhay from a cramped ghetto in Mumbai, meets Manjiri from Konkan in college. An unknown poetic love story begins.

videos.title: Starry Night
videos.overview: A fearless Abhay runs behind his uncertain dreams and his appetite for risky plans overwhelms Manjiri when he meets Ratan Kinkhwabwala.

videos.title: The Dice
videos.overview: Abhay is enamored by Ratan’s personality and makes a drastic plan confronting his brother Roxy. Manjiri succumbs to Abhay’s chaotic passion and experiences Ratan’s world that unravels a contrasting story.

videos.title: A Crossing
videos.overview: Manjiri navigates an unknown journey with Abhay as he makes a bold plan to win at Ratan’s gambling den. In the crossfire of love and ambition, a life lesson jolts David.

videos.title: Like A Sore Thumb
videos.overview: Manjiri witnesses Abhay’s entrepreneurial hunger in the most unexpected situation as he carefully plans an accident and gets his first big client. Glory and battle await.

videos.title: First Blood
videos.overview: Abhay's passion is fueled when he earns his first cheque from businessman Dhirendra Patel. Manjiri witnesses his undying dream becoming a reality but also a fear.

videos.title: Familiar Stranger
videos.overview: Abhay and Manjiri have to adjust to the impact of wealth on each other. Abhay accidentally meets Rohington Udeshi, who paves the way to him reaching his bigger goals. The domino effect begins.

videos.title: Sunset Point
videos.overview: Abhay manipulates his way to reach Anant Udeshi. His fervent quest to become super-rich and Manjiri’s idealistic way of life creates an unfamiliarity between them. An overwhelming revelation scars Manjiri and prompts her to take a decision.

videos.title: Daisies In The Desert
videos.overview: In the quietness of Konkan, Manjiri processes her current situation with Abhay. Abhay encounters a dilemma to choose his loyalty between the dissolute Anant Udeshi and his trusted friend Tukaram.

videos.title: Dizzy At The Mountain Top
videos.overview: Manjiri and Abhay reconvene in Konkan. Manjiri finds her answer in self-reflection and Abhay leaves with haunting questions.

videos.title: End Of The Tunnel
videos.overview: After a tragic event, Abhay reevaluates his self-destructive, complicated life. He takes a bold step against Anant Udeshi and vows to return stronger for the sake of Manjiri.
